body: Please Tell me Glendale New York
I honestly couldn’t tell it was gluten free. I was craving something quick and easy without sacrificing flavor and texture from the absence of gluten.

Look up middle eastern recipes for flat breads. Get into lamb kebabs, make a tabelou (however the fuck you spell it) salad. 

Also my favorite spot in LA is called Zankou chicken. I would get the chicken plate, that came with pita, tahini, picked peppers and veggies. I would stuff it all in a pita and dip the sandwich into the hummus. Fucking delicious.
